Trump AG Nominee Declines to Pledge Justice Department Independence

Todd Blanche, nominated by Donald Trump to be Attorney General, declined to pledge that the Justice Department would be independent of the White House during a television interview. When asked by an NBC anchor if he would pledge that the Department of Justice would be independent of the White House, Blanche stated, "I'm not going to pledge that." He also said that Trump would never cross a "legal line." The coverage also includes commentary on the potential dangers of Blanche's statements regarding abortion.
